---
title: "qeviz widget demo"
output: html_document
---

Two qeviz plots of one RS.data model, knitted as htmlwidgets (spec §7).

```{r setup, message = FALSE}
data(RS.data)
codes <- c("Data", "Technical.Constraints", "Performance.Parameters",
           "Client.and.Consultant.Requests", "Design.Reasoning", "Collaboration")
accum <- ena.accumulate.data(
  units        = RS.data[, c("Condition", "UserName")],
  conversation = RS.data[, c("Condition", "GroupName")],
  codes        = RS.data[, codes],
  window.size.back = 4
)
set <- ena.make.set(accum)
```

```{r first}
qe_plot(set, title = "FirstGame", group_col = "Condition", height = 420) |>
  qe_edges("FirstGame") |> qe_group("FirstGame") |>
  qe_labels(nodes = "on", font_size = 14, font_family = "Times New Roman")
```

```{r subtraction}
qe_plot(set, title = "FirstGame − SecondGame", group_col = "Condition", height = 420) |>
  qe_edges("FirstGame", compare = "SecondGame") |> qe_group() |>
  qe_labels(nodes = "on")
```
